markdown.headingText: Year of show vs Times Performed
markdown.markdown:
```{r}
#| label: fig-yearvsperformed
#| fig-cap: "Year of show vs times performed."
#| warning: false

library(ggplot2)
library (dplyr)

proddata <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/annika-bergstrom/csv-data-/refs/heads/main/SPT%20Production%20History%20-%20Sheet1.csv")

names(proddata)[names(proddata) == "Times Performed"] <- "Times_Performed"

year_average <- proddata %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(Average_Times_Performed = median(Times_Performed, na.rm = TRUE))

# Barplot
ggplot(year_average, aes(x=Year, y=Average_Times_Performed)) + 
  geom_point(stat = "identity") + geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x, 1), color = "red", se = TRUE)
```

## Genre vs Times Performed
```{r}
#| label: fig-genrevsperformed
#| fig-cap: "Genre vs Times Performed."
#| warning: false

library(ggplot2)
library (dplyr)
library (ggiraph)

proddata <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/annika-bergstrom/csv-data-/refs/heads/main/SPT%20Production%20History%20-%20Sheet1.csv")

names(proddata)[names(proddata) == "Times Performed"] <- "Times_Performed"

genre_average <- proddata %>%
  group_by(Genre) %>%
  summarise(Average_Times_Performed = mean(Times_Performed, na.rm = TRUE))

# Barplot
ggplot(genre_average, aes(x=Genre, y=Average_Times_Performed)) + 
  geom_bar_interactive(hover_nearest = TRUE, aes(tooltip = paste("Genre:", Genre, "\nAverage Times Performed:", round(Average_Times_Performed, 2))), stat = "identity") 

```

## Genre vs Show Season
```{r}
#| label: fig-genrevsseason
#| fig-cap: "Genre vs Show Season."
#| warning: false

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)


proddata <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/annika-bergstrom/csv-data-/refs/heads/main/SPT%20Production%20History%20-%20Sheet1.csv")

# variable assignment 
names(proddata)[names(proddata) == "Times Performed"] <- "Times_Performed"

names(proddata)[names(proddata) == "Fall "] <- "Fall"

season_counts <- proddata %>%
  count(Season)
season_genre_counts <- proddata %>%
  count(Season, Genre)

# Barplot
ggplot(season_genre_counts, aes(fill=Genre, x=Season, y= n)) + 
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity")
```

## Author vs Genre
```{r}
#| label: fig-authorvsgenre
#| fig-cap: "Author vs Genre."
#| warning: false

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

proddata <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/annika-bergstrom/csv-data-/refs/heads/main/SPT%20Production%20History%20-%20Sheet1.csv")

author_counts <- proddata %>%
  count(Author)
genre_author_counts <- proddata %>%
  count(Author, Genre)

proddata_grouped <- proddata %>%
  add_count(Author, name = "author_total") %>%
  mutate(
    author_grouped = if_else(author_total == 1, "Other", Author)
  )
# Count by grouped author and genre
plot_data <- proddata_grouped %>%
  count(author_grouped, Genre)

# Barplot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(fill=Genre, x=author_grouped, y= n)) + 
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity")
```

## Shakepeare Shows Over Time
```{r}
#| label: fig-shakespeareovertime
#| fig-cap: "Shakespeare vs Year."
#| warning: false

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

proddata <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/annika-bergstrom/csv-data-/refs/heads/main/SPT%20Production%20History%20-%20Sheet1.csv")

Shakespeare <- proddata %>%
  filter(Author == "William Shakespeare")

# count shakespeare productions by year
plot_data <- Shakespeare %>%
  count(Year)

# Bar chart
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x= Year, y= n)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity")
```
## Cast Size Change Over Time
```{r}
#| label: fig-castsizeovertime
#| fig-cap: "Cast Size Change Over Time"
#| warning: false
# Library
library(ggplot2)

# Create dummy data
proddata <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/annika-bergstrom/csv-data-/refs/heads/main/SPT%20Production%20History%20-%20Sheet1.csv")

# linear trend + confidence interval
ggplot(proddata, aes(x= Year, y= Cast_Size)) +
  geom_point() + geom_smooth(method=lm , color="red", fill="#69b3a2", se=TRUE)
```


## Genre vs Year
```{r}
#| label: fig-genrevsyear
#| fig-cap: "Genre vs Year"
#| warning: false

library(ggplot2)
library (dplyr)
library (ggiraph)
library (geomtextpath)

proddata <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/annika-bergstrom/csv-data-/refs/heads/main/SPT%20Production%20History%20-%20Sheet1.csv")

genre_counts <- proddata %>%
  count(Genre)
Year_genre_counts <- proddata %>%
  count(Year, Genre)
# Barplot
ggplot(Year_genre_counts, aes(x=Year, y= n, color=Genre, group=Genre)) + 
  geom_point(stat = "identity") + geom_labelsmooth(aes (label = Genre), fill = "white", method = "lm", formula = y ~ x)

```
